clamav_server_host_description: Where your ClamAV server is hosted. E.g.: localhost
clamav_server_port_description: The port for your ClamAV server. E.g: 3310
clamav_timeout_description: Timeout in milliseconds for virus scanning. Default: 10000 (10 seconds). Increase for large files.
clamav_max_file_size_description: Maximum file size in MB that can be scanned. Files larger than this will be rejected. Default: 100 MB. Set to 0 to disable limit.
clamav_allow_on_scan_failure_description: If enabled, files will be allowed to upload when scanning fails (e.g., ClamAV server is down). If disabled, uploads will be blocked. Default: false (block on failure).
clamav_notify_on_clean_description: If enabled, users will receive a notification when their file passes virus scanning. If disabled, only infected or failed scans will generate notifications. Default: false.
